## New
- A new download menu shows every quality, the codecs, audio and subtitles on one screen, and lets you pick the video's audio language (#1382)
- Download sits next to Save and Watch later in the video menu, Share moved to Options (#1432)
- Ask every time setting: turn it off to download at your download quality in one tap (#1432)
- Resume from headphones setting in Player & playback › Music (#1450)

## Improved
- Both download menus are now sheets, and in the player they open under the video like comments and the description (#1382)
- Settings show a shortcut to allow background activity when Android restricts Flow (#1450)

## Fixed
- Headphones no longer start music after you close Flow or after a video played (#1450)
- Home no longer swaps the feed at launch: videos you saw are left out and new ones wait behind a New videos button (#1447)
